titulo: Your Garage Fridge Costs More Than You Think #shorts
descripcion:
A second fridge costs the average home that has one about $90 a year, around 80% of what the main fridge costs (EIA RECS 2020 × 2026 U.S. electricity prices).

Full ranking of 15 appliances by yearly cost: see the related video.
